mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000000, 60000010, 60000020, 60000120) THEN '퇴원 시 상태' WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000040, 60000050, 60000070) THEN '퇴원 후 관리' WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000090) THEN '퇴원 후 건강관리(기타 안내사항)' WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000100) THEN '퇴원 후 건강관리 및 문의를 요하는 증상' END AS title, CASE WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000090, 60000100) THEN B.REC_CNTE ELSE C.NR_ITEM_NM || ' : ' || B.REC_CNTE END AS content FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRFAE B ON A.NREC_ID = B.NREC_ID AND B.LST_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON B.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.NREC_FORM_CD = '601' AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND title is not null ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000000, 60000010, 60000020, 60000120) THEN 1 WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000040, 60000050, 60000070) THEN 2 WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000090) THEN 3 WHEN C.NR_ITEM_ID IN (60000100) THEN 4 END, C.SORT_SEQ, B.NREC_DTL_ID

SELECT B.STF_NM AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD B ON A.FSR_STF_NO = B.STF_NO WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.NREC_FORM_CD = '601'
